name: Minty Pear, Mango & Banana Green Smoothie
instructions: This recipe will make about 8 cups. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed).
Roughly chop cucumber; transfer to a blender along with cold water and maple syrup. Blend until smooth.
Core and roughly chop pears; add to the blender.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Peel the bananas, break into chunks and add to the blender along with the spinach.
Add 8 ice cubes, edamame, and mango to the blender. Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into glasses and enjoy!
author: Mealime
